about_home.headline: Crafted with Love in Karachi
about_home.text: At Creations by H&I, we turn life's most special moments into cherished memories. Based in Karachi, our creative studio curates bespoke gift baskets, hand-tied floral arrangements, artisanal theme cakes, and royal wedding trousseau displays. Whether you are celebrating locally across Karachi or sending surprise gifts from Dubai and Jeddah to loved ones in Pakistan, we handcraft and deliver every creation with aesthetic perfection and personal warmth.

faq.question: How do I order customized gift baskets in Karachi?
faq.answer: Message us on WhatsApp with your budget, recipient details, and preferred items. We curate your gift basket, share preview photos for approval, and deliver on your chosen date.

faq.question: Can I send gifts to Pakistan from Dubai or Jeddah?
faq.answer: Yes. Many overseas clients in the UAE and Saudi Arabia order surprise gifts for family in Pakistan. We accept secure bank transfers and provide confirmed delivery photos.

faq.question: How far in advance should I book event decor in Karachi?
faq.answer: We recommend booking bridal showers and birthday setups 5 to 7 days ahead. For larger wedding stages and Aqeeqah events, book 2 to 3 weeks in advance.

faq.question: What is included in wedding trousseau packing?
faq.answer: We provide designer acrylic trays, bridal lehenga wraps, groom sherwani presentations, jewelry vanity boxes, and coordinated luggage styling tailored to your wedding theme.

faq.question: Can I customize the items inside a gift hamper?
faq.answer: Yes, every hamper is 100% custom made. You can choose chocolates like Godiva or Lindt, perfumes, scented candles, fresh flowers, and personalized greeting cards.

faq.question: Which cities do you deliver to?
faq.answer: We deliver fresh flowers, cakes, and decor across Karachi. Durable gift baskets, wooden crates, and photo frames are delivered nationwide to Lahore, Islamabad, Hyderabad, and other cities.
